name: Version history shows the audit trail

planSteps.description: Sign in as alex.rivera@soply.test with password Soply123! (fill the Email and Password fields on /login and click 'Sign in')
The page shows the heading 'Version history' with columns Version, SOP, Change summary, Changed by, Date, and Status
The audit table lists at least one version row for a published Finance SOP (e.g. 'Leave request' or 'Purchase order approval')
